detail: Full summary: A 2.x point release is a plugin change by construction: `npm version` rebuilds plugin/server (package.json:21), the launcher execs the committed bundle first (plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh:7-13), CI requires a bump in both version files for any plugin/ diff (.github/workflows/ci.yml:14-49). No 2.x point release exists; v1.21.1/v1.24.1 are the precedents. scripts/measure-plugin-tokens.sh:24 counts only skills/agents — tool-description growth is unmeasured
